blocks.text: Ruru Madrid has officially renewed his ties with GMA Network through a contract renewal event with its talent management arm, Sparkle GMA Artists Center. The actor celebrated the milestone at the event held on Thursday, Sept. 17, and attended by GMA executives Annette Gozon-Valdez, Joy Marcelo and Vic Del Rosario. Glimpses from the contract-signing were shared by Sparkle GMA through its social media pages. “A day of looking back at more than 10 years of milestones and memorable moments as a Kapuso,” the caption reads. “Primetime Action Hero Ruru Madrid celebrates another chapter as he renews his ties with Sparkle.
